```yaml
name: Auto-merge release into main

on:
  schedule:
    # 4am CST is 10:00 UTC (CST is UTC-6)
    - cron: "0 10 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  auto-merge:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.repository == 'jdx/mise'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check for open release PR
        id: check_pr
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # Look for an open PR from release to main
          PR_NUMBER=$(gh pr list \
            --base main \
            --head release \
            --state open \
            --json number \
            --jq '.[0].number')

          if [ -z "$PR_NUMBER" ]; then
            echo "No open PR from release to main found. Exiting."
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "Found open PR #${PR_NUMBER}"
          echo "pr_number=${PR_NUMBER}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Merge release PR
        if: steps.check_pr.outputs.pr_number != ''
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=${{ steps.check_pr.outputs.pr_number }}
          
          echo "Attempting to merge PR #${PR_NUMBER}..."
          
          # Try to merge with --auto to wait for checks
          # --merge specifies the merge method (create a merge commit)
          # If it fails (e.g., conflicts or checks failing), we catch it and exit 0
          if ! gh pr merge "${PR_NUMBER}" --merge --auto; then
            echo "Merge failed or was skipped (possibly due to conflicts or failing checks). Exiting gracefully."
            exit 0
          fi
          
          echo "PR #${PR_NUMBER} merged successfully."
```
